results.comment: The video was generally very accurate, but as a native Dane I managed to spot 3 minor mistakes:  1 (4:47): It is very true that Danes, Swedes and Norwegians can generally understand each other speaking their own languages, but this does not include Iceland. The reason Denmark has these 'regions' is because the Regional Councils subside over the budgets of hospitals, psychiatric institutions and similar medical facilities in their respective regions. You would NEVER hear a Dane say, "Oh, I am from the Region of Midtjylland- how about you?".  Overall, though, good content. Keep it up.
